extDescription.message: Grants claude.ai read/write access to a local folder you authorize. No install, no API key. Unofficial, not affiliated with Anthropic.
extDescription.description: Extension description, shown on the chrome://extensions details page

statusWaitingReady.description: Connection panel status line while the MCP handshake is pending

statusHandshakeFailed.message: Can't connect on this page (no active Claude conversation detected). Refresh the page and try again.
statusHandshakeFailed.description: Connection panel status line when the MCP handshake failed

statusChecking.description: Connection panel status line while restoring a previously authorized folder

statusDisconnected.description: Connection panel status line when no folder is connected

statusConnected.description: Connection panel status line when a folder is connected; $1 is the folder name

statusNeedsReauth.description: Connection panel status line when permission needs to be re-granted; $1 is the folder name

btnChangeFolder.description: Button: switch to a different folder

btnReauthorize.description: Button: re-request permission for an expired connection

previewLoading.description: Placeholder title shown while the folder content preview is being read

previewContains.description: Folder preview title; $1 is a comma-separated list of entry names

previewEmpty.description: Folder preview text when the folder has no entries

previewMore.description: Appended to the folder preview when there are more entries than shown; $1 is the total entry count

previewFailed.description: Folder preview title when reading the preview failed; $1 is the folder name, $2 is the error message

confirmTitle.description: Diff confirmation dialog title fallback (used when no path/title is supplied)

diffOmitted.description: Diff renderer: collapsed-run marker for unchanged lines; $1 is the omitted line count

popupConnectHint.message: Go to the claude.ai page and click "Connect folder" in the bottom-right corner.
popupConnectHint.description: Toolbar popup: guidance text pointing the user to the connection panel on claude.ai
